# Cursor

## Identity
Cursor should be treated as a category-correct reference system for ai-coding-tool, using technical, minimal as the guiding visual attitude.

## Use When
- ai-coding-tool
- coding assistant
- editor
- ai code editor
- developer assistant
- developer-tools
- ai

## Core Visual Rules
- Keep the composition faithful to ai, developer expectations.
- Let technical, minimal shape typography, spacing, surfaces, and motion.
- Make the result feel native to developer-tools, ai rather than generic premium marketing.
- Keep the layout restrained and minimal when product clarity matters more than ornament.

## Category Alignment
- Family: external
- Categories: ai, developer
- Industries: developer-tools, ai
- Product types: ai-coding-tool
- Style keywords: technical, minimal

## Capabilities
- Supports severe restraint and minimal product-showcase framing.

## Compatible Support Systems
- Raycast can be referenced only for minor supporting polish, never as an overpowering second primary.
- Warp can be referenced only for minor supporting polish, never as an overpowering second primary.
- Vercel can be referenced only for minor supporting polish, never as an overpowering second primary.

## Avoid
- generic AI-generated SaaS hero stacks
- purple-on-dark Bolt defaults

## Prompting Note
- If this reference is selected as the primary system, it controls composition, typography attitude, palette behavior, CTA styling, imagery direction, and motion language.
- Do not describe the output as inspired by another brand unless that other brand was explicitly selected instead.
- Treat this file as binding build guidance, not as an optional moodboard.
